verdict.rationale: The ecosystem shows clear signs of life. There is a third-party curated awesome-jev list (1,253 stars, 339 entries across 14 categories, including 57 infra/SDK/integration entries), community open-weight replicas on Hugging Face, and hands-on use of Jev through the OpenRouter router; the SDK changelog also adds AI-gateway examples. Nothing shows that these lists, tools and integrations have active maintainers, so the verdict is partial rather than full. Missing for 10: evidence of active maintenance (recent commits, release cadence, maintainer activity) on third-party tools and integrations, independent corroboration of how deep the router/gateway integrations go beyond a single community mention, and named, well-maintained third-party integrations beyond list counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the community ecosystem around the model is genuinely alive — curated lists, third-party tools, routers, and integrations with active maintainers
